_comment: OpenCatalogi capability matrix. Authored here; the cross-product index in market-intelligence is generated from it. Generated by a lane script on 2026-09-25 from rows, research citations and code-reading packs; see the PR body for the method, the row-source split and the column choice.
category: A self-hosted publication platform for Dutch public bodies that turns records held in OpenRegister into public catalogues and serves them to every channel that must read them: residents through a reading room (rendered by Portaliq), the national Woo-index through DiWoo sitemaps, data.overheid.nl and European portals through DCAT-AP, search engines through schema.org, and other organisations through a federated directory. Its category is the Woo publication platform (actieve openbaarmaking: xxllnc Publiceren, iprox.open, Decos JOIN Woo Portaal, Acato WooPortaal), and it overlaps the open data portals (CKAN, DKAN) on catalogue, harvest and DCAT publishing. It is NOT an enterprise metadata catalogue (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Collibra), a developer portal (Backstage) or an architecture tool (LeanIX), although 58 of the 79 competitors the intelligence database links to it are those; the software catalogue those serve is Stackiq's category. If this paragraph is wrong, the columns and areas below are wrong with it: correct it here first.
